body: FORMAL REVIEW — BLOCK cand-0JAC5GG7FXPVDD42V92A1V3VCD exact c7a316ab9f043f88a8e64585c4df4f86790700d5. The CellCoordinates court itself passes 2/2 after a clean isolated rebuild, but the replacement Mirror anchor does not satisfy the stated rot-proof contract. PlattScaling is not an invariant-free Cartesian record: public construction accepts steps <= 0 and non-finite learningRate; fit performs no validation. Independent exact-tree regression `PlattScaling(steps = 1, learningRate = Double.NaN).fit(scores, labels).isLeft` fails because fit returns Right, and the published model later reaches Probability.unsafe with NaN. This is the same single-field lawful-subrange class as BelowMembership, so PlattScaling is itself a plausible sealing/smart-constructor target. The re-anchor therefore merely moves the future dependency. Required narrow successor: define a test-only deliberately Cartesian control record in the probe package, independent of production vocabulary; positively prove both Mirror.ProductOf summon and companion fromProduct on that control; retain type visibility and checked-factory controls; remove the duplicate CellCoordinates visibility assertion. No production source change is needed. Restored exact tree is clean.
